highlights.title: 面向多智能体学习的鲁棒高效通信（MARC）
highlights.title_en: Robust and Efficient Communication for Multi-Agent Learning
highlights.glance: 用条件互信息正则逼出「抗丢包」通信协议
highlights.problem: 分布式智能的基石是通信，但现有 MARL 通信方法在物理约束（带宽瓶颈、有损信道、消息压缩）下会迅速崩坏——学到的消息既不紧凑也不抗噪，离真实机器人网络部署差一大截。痛点直指「通信的信息密度 vs 鲁棒性」这一对矛盾。
method: 提出 MARC（Multi-Agent Regularized Communication），理论根基是条件互信息——用消息去最小化关于「未来系统状态」的不确定性，即直接对「这条消息到底降低了多少状态预测熵」做优化。
架构上采用 attention-based 消息编码器，配合独特的消息正则化机制，诱导网络自发学到高表征力的通信协议，而不是靠人工设计消息格式。
收益设计上把通信代价显式写进目标：在严格带宽瓶颈 + 有损信道的仿真下训练，让协议在压缩下依然保真。
highlights.result: 在复杂协作域中显著优于 SOTA；关键战绩是在大幅数据压缩下仍维持高运行性能，并给出了消息特性的深度分析（消息到底编码了什么）。
highlights.insight: 这是「把信息论目标直接当正则项」的干净范式，比常见的 Gumbel-Softmax / 离散化字典更可解释。做无人机集群或车路协同时，可以直接照搬其「在训练时就注入信道损伤，而不是测试时才加」的实验协议；另外其「消息表征分析」章节值得抄——这是审稿人最爱问「你学到的 message 到底是什么意思」的标准答案模板。

highlights.title: 马尔可夫 α-势博弈中去中心化学习的高概率纳什遗憾界
highlights.title_en: High-Probability Nash Regret for Decentralized Learning in Markov α-Potential Games
highlights.glance: 首次给出全在线异步去中心化 NE 遗憾界
highlights.problem: 多智能体强化学习里最顽固的理论痛点——分布失配系数（distribution-mismatch coefficient）会随状态空间规模爆炸式增长，导致绝大多数 NE 遗憾界在大规模问题上形同虚设；同时「全在线异步更新」这一最贴近现实的设定，长期缺少有限时间保证。
method: 在无限视界折扣马尔可夫博弈 + bandit feedback 下，聚焦 Markov α-potential games（近似势博弈），设计 KL 投影自然策略梯度（KL-projected NPG）算法，覆盖 episodic 与 fully-online 两种设定。
核心理论突破：把分布失配系数从界里彻底消掉，同时还能容纳势函数近似误差 α、估计神谕偏置、转移敏感性三类不完美性。
识别 state-wise potential structure，得到对 α 只呈加性依赖的更尖锐保证；并特化到独立资源马尔可夫拥塞博弈（IMCG），构造去中心化估计神谕。
highlights.result: 有限时间高概率 NE 遗憾界达到 Õ(T^{-1/4})（episodic）与 Õ(T^{-2/15})（fully online）；应用落点是随机机器上的战略性在线作业调度。这是该设定下首个有限时间高概率保证。
highlights.insight: 如果你在做大规模 MARL 的理论侧，这篇给出了「如何干掉分布失配系数」的完整技术路径。工程侧更实用的启发是：把拥塞 / 调度 / 资源竞争类问题先证明它是 α-势博弈，就能直接套用带保证的去中心化算法，而不必硬怼一般和博弈的不可解性。

highlights.title: 动态网络上的去中心化最优均衡学习
highlights.title_en: Decentralized Optimal Equilibrium Learning Over Dynamic Networks
highlights.glance: 只传「表」不传参数，动态网络下选社会最优均衡
highlights.problem: 有限标准型博弈里存在多个均衡，去中心化学习往往收敛到社会次优的那一个；而当通信拓扑随时间变化、且每个 agent 只看得到自己的 realized payoff（不预先知道博弈结构）时，问题更棘手。
method: 设计网络化去中心化最优均衡学习动力学：agents 从局部收益比较中生成随机化的「满意 / 不满」（content/discontent）语义信号。
通信设计是最大亮点——不传动作、不传收益、不传本地估计或参数，只交换带时间戳的时间堆叠表（time-stamped time-stacked tables）；用 table fusion + 时域多数重构抵消动态拓扑带来的信息漂移。
收益侧以功利主义与比例公平社会福利为目标，配合同相探索扰动实现最优均衡选择。
highlights.result: 给出有限时间对数遗憾保证；仿真验证能在动态通信网络上有效选出社会合意的均衡。
highlights.insight: 「传表不传梯度」是一个被严重低估的设计哲学——它同时解决隐私、带宽和拓扑时变三个问题。另外它把「均衡选择」而非「均衡计算」作为目标，是比单纯 regret minimization 更贴近现实部署的取向。

highlights.title: CoRe-MARL：未知动态下的协同再分配
highlights.title_en: CoRe-MARL: Cooperative Redistribution Under Unknown Dynamics Using Recurrent Multi-Agent RL
highlights.glance: Dec-POMDP + 递归 MAPPO 做救灾物资再分配
highlights.problem: 应急救灾物资分发网络中，各地方中心面临需求与供给动态未知、信息受限、运输中断的三重不确定；各中心独立决策导致服务可得性严重不均衡——典型的非平稳 + 部分可观测协同问题。
method: 形式化为 Dec-POMDP，每个中心是一个 agent，学习物资再分配策略。
收益函数不是简单最大化总量，而是提升最差区域的服务水平 + 缩小区域间服务差距，同时保护全网总服务量——显式的 max-min / 公平性塑形奖励。
算法上用递归网络捕捉不可直接观测的供需演化动态，配合 MAPPO（CTDE：集中训练分散执行）。
highlights.result: 对比递归 IPPO 与纯本地启发式：MAPPO 缩小了跨中心服务差距、提升了服务最差中心的表现，同时维持有竞争力的全网服务水平，且在不同轨迹模式下表现稳定。
highlights.insight: 这篇是「MARL 做公共治理 / 资源分配」的优秀模板，尤其是把公平性指标写进奖励而非事后评估这一做法，以及让 critic 也处于部分可观测这种更诚实的实验设定——后者是很多 MARL 论文的隐形水分所在，值得警惕和借鉴。

highlights.title: 一般和博弈中乐观 Hedge 的对数遗憾界
highlights.title_en: A Logarithmic Regret Bound for Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games
highlights.glance: 常数步长把自博弈遗憾压到 O(√n log d log T)
highlights.problem: 一个漂亮的基础问题：简单的无悔动力学在自博弈中，能否比对抗任意对手时拿到更小的遗憾？Daskalakis et al. 2021 已把 Optimistic Hedge 的个体遗憾从 O(√T) 改进到 O(n log d_i log⁴ T)，本文追问：还能再压吗？
method: 证明 Optimistic Hedge 采用常数步长 η = Θ(1/(√n log T)) 时，在期望损失向量反馈下可达到 O(√n log d_i log T) 的个体外部遗憾——把 log⁴T 直接砍到 log T。
技术核心：证明概率加权成对损失差距的高阶差分的阶乘界（factorial bounds），再在固定欧氏范数下做有限差分插值。
推论：时间平均策略的 CCE gap 为 O(√n log d log T / T)。
highlights.result: 从 O(n log d_i log⁴ T) 改进到 O(√n log d_i log T)，且允许更大的步长——这正是加速的根源。
highlights.insight: 「更大步长 = 更快收敛」在这里被严格化了，做自博弈算法调参时可直接参考 η 的标度律。更重要的启示是方法论层面的：自博弈 ≠ 对抗设定，把「对手也在学习」这一结构性信息写进分析，能拿到比 worst-case 强得多的界——这几乎是当前 MARL 理论最主要的红利来源。

highlights.title: 通过乐观转移矩阵实现一般和博弈中的常数交换遗憾
highlights.title_en: Constant Swap Regret in General-Sum Games via Optimistic Transition Matrices
highlights.glance: 一般和博弈中首次做到与 T 无关的常数交换遗憾
highlights.problem: Swap regret 是比外部遗憾强得多的概念——收敛到相关均衡（CE）而非 CCE。在一般和博弈中做到常数级（不随 T 增长）swap regret 长期是开放问题。
method: 给出确定性、非耦合（uncoupled）的学习动力学：每个玩家预测自己的偏离收益，用该预测更新一个行随机转移矩阵，然后按其平稳分布出牌。
证明组合拳：利用平稳性的势函数论证 + 双尺度高阶预测分析，并用有根树表示处理偏离收益对平稳分布的非线性依赖。
鲁棒性扩展：通过通用 common-prefix switching wrapper 得到对抗鲁棒变体，自博弈界只损失一个普适常数。
highlights.result: n 个玩家、每人至多 m 个动作时，每个有限视界上每个玩家的个体 swap regret 为 O(√n · m log m · log^{5/2}(nm))——与 T 无关；对抗设定下 swap regret ≤ 7√(mT log m)。
highlights.insight: 「用转移矩阵的平稳分布出牌」是个非常优雅的技巧——它把「随机化策略」从显式的概率向量变成了动力学的稳态，天然适配 uncoupled 设定。做多智能体均衡求解器时，这个表示法值得尝试替换掉传统的 softmax / Hedge 参数化。

highlights.title: 通过参考策略在正则化自博弈中操纵均衡选择
highlights.title_en: Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy
highlights.glance: 把 RLHF 的 KL 锚点当成「均衡选择器」
highlights.problem: 正则化自博弈（DeepNash 打 Stratego 的那一族方法）在遇到价值等价均衡构成的多面体时，正则项会「静默地」替你选一个——均匀参考策略下选中的是最大熵的那个成员。核心疑问：能不能反过来，把参考策略当成旋钮，主动指定要哪个均衡？
method: 理论刻画：自博弈收敛到参考策略 ρ 在 Nash 集上的 I-projection；选择遵循 reach-weighted I-projection。
方法论配方极其简洁：把参考策略锚定在目标均衡成员上，然后逐步 refine。这重新解释了 RLHF 中的 KL 锚点——它不只是稳定性缰绳，更是选择旋钮。
实验设计极严谨：5 个精确可解博弈 + 1 个 2-D 均衡多面体，精确最优反应（不是近似）、跨独立种子的等价性检验（TOST）。
highlights.result: 引导到目标成员的平均坐标误差 0.007，中位可剥削性 5×10⁻⁵，TOST 等价性在 ±0.05 内；选择遵循 reach-weighted I-projection（斜率 0.969，95% CI [0.950, 0.987]）。同等篇幅报告失败案例：固定离流形参考要付 0.08–0.25 可剥削性代价；边界目标会 undershoot。反直觉发现：面对最优反应对手时 steering 毫无意义——只在面对固定的非均衡对手时才起作用。
highlights.insight: 「锚定 + 细化」配方可以直接用于麻将 / 斗地主 / 兵棋等中国场景的均衡选择——你不再只能拿到「某个」纳什，而是能挑「你想要的那个」。另外「KL 锚点 = 选择旋钮」这个 reinterpretation 对 RLHF 对齐研究有直接的迁移价值：你在对齐时选的不只是安全，还是一个特定的均衡。

highlights.title: 网络安全博弈的高效纳什均衡计算（RWPS）
highlights.title_en: Efficient Nash Equilibrium Computation for Cybersecurity Games
highlights.glance: 按对手均衡混合加权采样，PSRO 预算省 4~6 倍
highlights.problem: 用 PSRO 求解基于仿真的网络安全博弈时，瓶颈极其明确：收益矩阵每一格都要跑一次慢速仿真器的蒙特卡洛 rollout，而策略训练和受限博弈求解反而很便宜。预算全烧在「填格子」上了。
method: 提出 RWPS（Regret-Weighted Payoff Sampling）：一个预算化估计器，只仿真均衡真正敏感的单元格，其余用已在本次运行中仿真过的数据上训练的代理模型填充。
理论关键：传统的 sup-norm 误差界对这种「故意留一些格子不准」的估计器根本无法评价。作者证明了一个 instance-dependent 界——按对手的均衡混合对误差加权，且该证书仅从仿真数据即可计算。
覆盖性定理：一旦「偏离相关集」被真实仿真覆盖，代理误差就无法影响任一玩家的遗憾——这给了「什么时候可以放心用代理」的可判定条件。
highlights.result: 在 3 个 21×21 一般和博弈上，精化后的界比估计器自身输出紧 4~6 倍；覆盖性结果能事先预判哪些博弈便宜：小支撑博弈只需仿真 18% 的矩阵，而 Blotto 需要 82%。在 CyGym 与 ANSG 两个网络安全仿真器上，最小预算时表现最好。
highlights.insight: 这是本期最可直接落地的一篇。「按均衡敏感性分配仿真预算」——把 sup-norm 换成对手均衡混合加权，是能立刻用在任何 simulation-based 博弈求解上的技巧（麻将 / 兵棋 / 电力市场仿真同理）。「用覆盖性定理预判问题难度」（18% vs 82%）这个做法非常有说服力，建议在实验章节加一张类似的「预算-精度」前沿图。

highlights.title: 廉价沟通稳定 LLM 智能体间的策略互动
highlights.title_en: Cheap Talk Stabilizes Strategic Interaction in LLM Agents
highlights.section: LLM 多智能体与社会模拟
highlights.glance: 无约束赛前沟通可稳定 LLM 策略轨迹
highlights.problem: LLM 被越来越多地部署为相互博弈的智能体，但一个被忽视的可靠性问题是：它们的行动策略在重复互动中是否稳定（persistent）？轨迹会莫名其妙翻转——这对需要长期协作的多智能体系统是致命的。
method: 实验设计干净：4 个开源 7–9B 模型 × 4 个重复两人博弈（囚徒困境 / 雪堆 / 猎鹿 / 和谐博弈）× 6 种情境框架，检验智能体自生成的、无约束的赛前沟通（cheap talk）能否提升策略持续性。
机制拆解做得很深：受控的 current-message 干预识别出 Qwen 中两个可分离的输出层通道——降低行动不确定性、减少行动概率的轮间漂移。
因果性证据：在囚徒困境中于 Qwen / Falcon 的 Transformer 后期层识别出一条「历史平衡的策略-内容方向」，把它投影掉会增加闭环博弈中的实际切换率。
highlights.result: 四个博弈中都观察到不稳定轨迹；cheap talk  predominantly 稳定化，其中 5 次修正性反转集中在社交 / 团队框架下。
highlights.insight: 「说话不花钱但有用」——这是博弈论经典结论在 LLM 时代的复现，给你的 LLM 多智能体系统加一轮赛前沟通是低成本高收益的改进。其机制可解释方法（层内方向识别 + 投影干预 + 反事实）是 LLM 博弈研究的标准范式。它也诚实指出效应高度依赖模型和情境，提示别把单模型结论当普适规律。

highlights.title: 递归推理还是统计外推？多智能体相依决策中的上下文学习
highlights.title_en: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making
highlights.section: LLM 多智能体与社会模拟
highlights.glance: REE 基准证明 ICL 更像统计外推而非战略推理
highlights.problem: LLM agent 靠 ICL 利用交互历史改进决策，但这究竟是真正的递归信念推理（「我猜你认为我认为…」），还是仅仅在外推历史统计规律？这是判断 LLM 能否胜任战略环境的分水岭问题。
method: 构造多智能体不完美信息博弈（公共品博弈），这类博弈必须做递归信念推理才能解好。
诊断工具是关键创新：引入 REE（理性预期均衡）作为基准——REE 是与历史无关的，因此「偏离 REE 的程度」就能量化 ICL 到底是推理还是外推。
干预方式：操纵历史反馈的统计结构（而非改博弈本身），观察决策质量如何变化，并以战略相互依赖强度作为调节变量。
highlights.result: 当历史统计模式被打乱时，长上下文带来的收益基本消失，决策质量退化到无上下文基线水平；且这种退化被更强的战略相互依赖显著放大。结论：在此类战略环境中，ICL 行为更符合统计外推而非战略推理。
highlights.insight: REE 基准是一个可复用的诊断工具，你可以直接用它拷问任何「LLM 会博弈」的宣称。实验设计上的精妙之处在于——只破坏统计结构、不动博弈结构，从而干净地分离了两条通路。这个「用无历史基准做对照组」的思路，可以推广到拍卖、谈判、议价等各种 LLM 战略场景的可信度审计。

highlights.title: 旗帜博弈：机制性群体可解释性的玩具模型
highlights.title_en: Flag Game: A Toy Model for Mechanistic Swarm Interpretability
highlights.section: LLM 多智能体与社会模拟
highlights.glance: 群体信念「坍缩→极化」相变 + 机制可解释
highlights.problem: AI agent 的涌现式协调行为正成为关键安全风险，而驱动它的核心现象是信念的快速形成与传播。要集体对齐，必须先有机制层面的理解——但真实多智能体系统太复杂，缺一个可解剖的玩具模型。
method: 设计 Flag Game：隐藏的国旗是真值，每个有界 agent 只直接观测私有局部裁剪图，但可以交换信念并对同伴的社会性证据加权。
关键发现（相变）：小群体出现集体信念坍缩（collapse），随规模增大转变为集体信念极化（polarization）；正是极化导致了大群体下的性能下降，但也创造了集体信念的多样性。
两套互补的机制剖析工具：社会回路归因（预测哪个 agent、哪种观点对集体动态最关键，并用 agent patching 验证）；以及统计力学理论并在大群体下验证其匹配经验相图。
highlights.result: 复现非单调规模缩放、信念坍缩→极化相变；社会回路归因的预测经因果干预验证；统计力学理论与经验相图吻合。
highlights.insight: 这篇是「用玩具模型 + 统计力学做多智能体可解释性」的范本，方法上完全可以照着搭一个「中国象棋残局版」或「多智能体辩论版」的 Flag Game。更实用的启发是那个非单调规模效应——「人多不一定好」在群体智能里有明确的机制解释，这给设计 LLM 委员会 / 辩论系统的最优规模提供了理论抓手。

highlights.title: 涌现世界：长程多智能体系统的对抗性压力测试
highlights.title_en: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
highlights.section: LLM 多智能体与社会模拟
highlights.glance: 85 万次 LLM 调用、16 天长程对抗压力测试
highlights.problem: AI agent 正从「有界任务」走向「持续部署」，失败会通过记忆、工具、其他 agent 和环境状态在交互结束很久之后继续传播——这是一个无法通过孤立评估模型回答来刻画的安全体制。
method: 搭建 Emergence World：持续运行的多智能体环境，8 个并行世界 × 每世界 10 个 agent，从完全相同的初始条件出发；其中 7 个同质世界各由一个前沿模型驱动 + 1 个混合模型世界。
Agent 拥有持久记忆、可创建 / 使用工具、并治理共享制度——这构成了完整的「智能体社会」。
压力测试：在操作状态充分累积之后，通过普通交互界面投放三类受控事件——间接提示注入、虚假信息、私有记忆泄露。
highlights.result: 跨越 16 天，产生 >85 万次 LLM 调用、近 500 亿 token。没有任何一个世界在三类事件上实现完全韧性；检测不等于遏制——系统能识别威胁，却仍与对抗内容交互、把它写进自己的持久记忆，并在长达 46 小时后据其行动。还暴露了目标漂移、私下不同意却公开从众、对分派工作的协同拒绝。
highlights.insight: 核心结论值得反复咀嚼——模型级对齐不是可组合的（alignment is not compositional）：单个看起来安全能干的 agent，能组成具有质变失败模式的系统。因此安全前沿正从「对齐模型」转向「工程化有韧性的自主系统」。其「同质 vs 混合种群对照 + 长时程累积后再施压」的设计是评测多智能体系统的金标准。

highlights.title: 向未对齐智能体授权：联盟对齐与安全控制
highlights.title_en: Delegating Authorization to Misaligned Agents: Coalitional Alignment and Safe Control
highlights.glance: k-robust 联盟对齐：容忍 k 张反对票仍保证安全
highlights.problem: 长时运行的 AI agent 构成控制难题。若 agent 未完全对齐，要保证安全就得在执行前批准每个后果性动作；但每步都找人审批，人类注意力成为瓶颈。委托给别的 AI agent 审阅？审阅者本身也可能未对齐——问题递归了。
method: 提出问题：需要什么样的审阅面板条件，才能弱于「个体对齐」，却仍足以保证委托方的期望效用不低于某个指定基线策略？
核心定理：每个审阅 agent 报告「该提案是否优于基线」；容忍 k 张反对票的阈值规则是安全的，当且仅当——移除任意 k 个审阅者后，委托方的效用仍可写为剩余审阅者效用的非负组合，再加一个在所有可行提案上非负的项。作者称之为 k-robust coalitional alignment。这是充要条件。
两个扩展：序贯控制——在带任意 proposer 的折扣 MDP 上，「每状态安全」是该策略匹配或超越基线的充要条件；策略性投票——全面板覆盖保证一致同意规则下每个纳什均衡都是安全的，而更宽松的阈值即使审阅者个体对齐也会引入不安全均衡。
highlights.result: 用现有 reviewer 模型做实验，表明即使没有个体对齐的审阅者、且容忍部分反对票，集体审阅仍可保持可靠性（sound）。
highlights.insight: 这是本期理论最优雅的一篇，且直击 AI 治理最现实的问题——AI 监督 AI 的合法性基础是什么。其「非负组合 + k-移除」的刻画可以直接形式化为你自己多智能体系统里「需要几个 reviewer、容忍几票反对」的设计准则。尤其那条「更宽松的阈值会让策略性投票产生不安全均衡」，是所有做 AI 审核 / 投票机制的人必须知道的陷阱。

highlights.title: 异构协同感知的对抗鲁棒性研究（HetPoison / HetShield）
highlights.title_en: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception
highlights.glance: 异构协同感知的「异构即防御」是幻觉
highlights.problem: 异构协同感知让不同传感器配置的网联车辆通过紧凑特征图共享空间感知。已有工作证明同质 CP 中单个恶意 agent 能抹掉邻居融合场景中的真实物体。但业界广泛假设异构性天然防御这类攻击。本文直接检验：这个假设成立吗？
method: 构建 matched-objective harness：标准化扰动预算、目标函数和前向路径，确保公平对比——这一步很关键，之前的「鲁棒性差距」可能是实验设置不统一造成的假象。
攻击侧（HetPoison）：提出一个学习型生成器，在单次、无标签的前向传播中生成物体移除扰动，且跨主要异构设计迁移、无需访问受害者检测器。
防御侧（HetShield）：轻量级信任层，校验特征间的时空一致性。
highlights.result: 「异构即防御」在很大程度上是幻觉：经过适当调参的迭代攻击能抹平甚至反转表观鲁棒性差距。HetPoison 匹配或超过昂贵的优化型攻击。HetShield 能恢复 83–95% 被攻击掉的精度。
highlights.insight: 做多智能体安全的，请把「异构性不是防御」作为默认假设写进 threat model，而不是当作安全论据。其 matched-objective harness 方法论极值得抄——多智能体对抗论文的许多「鲁棒性提升」其实是预算 / 目标不对齐造成的测量假象。

highlights.title: 面向 ROI 约束投标人的拍卖设计：真实性与收益最大化
highlights.title_en: Auction Design with ROI-Constrained Bidders: Truthfulness and Revenue Maximization
highlights.glance: σ-增量机制逼近 Myerson 最优
highlights.problem: 投资回报率（ROI）约束在许多拍卖中居于核心地位，尤其在线广告——投标人不愿支付超过所获价值的固定比例。当估值与 ROI 约束都是私有信息时，如何设计既真实又收益最大化的机制？这是 Myerson 框架在 ROI 约束下的推广难题。
method: 刻画定理：当估值与 ROI 约束均为私有时，刻画了真实拍卖的结构——分配规则唯一决定支付规则（强结构结果，把设计空间压缩到只需设计分配）。
多投标人：提出 σ-增量机制（σ-increment mechanisms），形似 Myerson 最优机制；当 σ→0 时，该机制在所有确定性真实机制中渐近最优，收益至少达到所有真实机制中最优期望收益的 1/r̄ 分数。
单投标人：证明任何真实拍卖都可被一个凸定价函数替代，且对每种类型支付都不更低；并在估值或 ROI 约束之一为公开信息时，导出最优定价函数。
highlights.result: 纯理论结果，但给出了明确的近似比保证（1/r̄ 下界）与渐近最优性，以及单买家情形的闭式最优定价。
highlights.insight: 在线广告 / 算力竞价 / 广告位分配场景中，ROI 约束是硬性业务现实而非学术假设。其「分配规则唯一决定支付规则」的刻画是设计带预算 / ROI 约束机制时的强力化简工具。对做 AI 算力市场、广告拍卖、甚至 GPU 资源调度竞价的研究者，这篇是必读的机制设计底稿。

highlights.title: 交易大厅中的传染：对抗信号如何在多智能体交易系统中扩散
highlights.title_en: Contagion on the Trading Floor: How Adversarial Signals Spread in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
highlights.glance: 仅靠社交媒体投毒就能击穿多智能体交易系统
highlights.problem: 基于 LLM 的多智能体交易系统正进入量化金融，但其对对抗输入的鲁棒性基本未知。尤其危险的是——这类系统的输入天然包含不可信的社交媒体信息流，而单个 agent 手握真实资本的执行权。
method: 提出 GMATS 框架，抽象现代多智能体交易架构；实例化一类黑盒投毒攻击者——把 LLM 当作「帖子生成器」，向分析师的证据流中注入预算受限、看起来良性的社交媒体内容（纯输入、仅通过 admissible feeds 进入）。
定义传染度量（contagion metrics）：追踪对抗内容如何在堆栈中传播，包括分析师层与协调层的信念漂移分数，以及回测指标上的「攻击 vs 干净」差值。
防御侧结论：合适的多智能体拓扑与协调器提示词可以阻尼对抗冲击。
highlights.result: 在含历史市场与社交数据的离线安全基准上，即使是简单的纯输入攻击也能实质性劣化风险收益特征——显著压低夏普比率；同时，恰当设计的拓扑与协调器提示能在相同投毒预算下提升平均鲁棒性。
highlights.insight: 这是「LLM 多智能体系统的攻击面 = 其输入通道」这一事实的最清晰演示。两个可迁移点：belief-shift 分层度量是量化「对抗信号在系统内传播」的通用指标；「拓扑即防御」——多智能体架构不只是性能选择，更是安全参数。

trends: 理论主线：把「自博弈 ≠ 对抗」榨干。第 5、6 两篇同期独立地把一般和博弈的遗憾界砍到 log T 乃至常数级，共同手法都是「利用对手也在用同类算法更新」这一结构性信息。这是当前博弈学习理论最肥的红利带。
均衡研究的重心正在从「算出一个」转向「选出想要的那个」。Steering 把 KL 锚点 reinterpret 成选择旋钮，Decentralized Optimal Equilibrium 把社会福利写进均衡选择目标——均衡的多解性正被当作资源而非麻烦。
仿真昂贵的博弈求解进入「预算智能分配」时代。RWPS 给出可判定的覆盖性条件，能提前预判问题是「18% 还是 82%」。这个方向对麻将 / 兵棋 / 电力市场等比仿真器昂贵得多的问题几乎是必然选择。
LLM 多智能体的安全研究完成了从「单点失效」到「系统性失效」的范式跃迁。Emergence World 等共同指向一个结论：对齐不是可组合的——个体安全的 agent 组成的社会会出现质变失败模式，且失败会沿记忆、工具、隐式通信路径长程传播。
群体智能的「人多力量大」正在被系统性证伪。Flag Game 给出机制解释（小群体信念坍缩 → 大群体极化），同族工作则从模型池选择、任务依赖结构两个角度给出边界条件：多智能体的优势被任务结构而非 agent 数量决定。
note: 本期由本地人工精读回填：arXiv 索引窗口 2026-09-13 ~ 2026-09-17 共命中 131 篇去重论文，经四项筛选标准精读摘要后精选 16 篇；下方雷达为脚本自动抓取的补充条目。

radar.title: A Proposal for an Agentic AI Architecture to Support Multi-Domain Decision-Making in the Brazilian Armed Forces
authors: Henrique Curi de Miranda e Lourenço Alves Pereira
radar.summary: The growing complexity of multi-domain operational environments (land, aerospace, naval, cyber, and electromagnetic spectrum) has increased the volume and velocity of data reaching command-and-control (C2) centers, straining the observe-orient-decide-act (OODA) decision cycle. Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems currently employed in defense are, in general, reactive and isolated tools that still rely heavily on human operators to integrate information, assess scenarios, and formulate courses of action. This paper proposes a conceptual Agentic AI architecture for AI systems that can plan, access data sources, execute tools, and act autonomously and audibly, aimed at supporting decision-making across the three Brazilian Armed Forces (Navy, Army, and Air Force). Four application fronts are discussed (decision support, situational analysis, feasibility studies, and countermeasure suggestion), as well as the data and sensor access requirements and the security and permission safeguards necessary for responsible employment across administrative, strategic, operational, and tactical contexts.
radar.summary_short: The growing complexity of multi-domain operational environments (land, aerospace, naval, cyber, and electromagnetic spectrum) has increased the volume and velocity of data reaching command-and-control (C2) centers, straining the observe-orient-decide-act (OODA) decision cycle.

radar.title: A Nearly Tight Lower Bound for Matroid Intersection Prophet Inequalities
radar.summary: We study prophet inequalities under intersections of $q$ partition matroids, where an online algorithm irrevocably selects elements with independent nonnegative values drawn from known distributions and revealed in an adversarial order. We prove an $Ω(q/\log q)$ lower bound on the competitive ratio. Together with the known $O(q)$ upper bounds, this resolves, up to a logarithmic factor, the optimal dependence on $q$, an open question posed by Correa, Cristi, Fielbaum, Pollner, and Weinberg (IPCO 2022) and Saxena, Velusamy, and Weinberg (ITCS 2023). Our construction also yields an $Ω(d/\log d)$ lower bound for $d$-single-minded auctions, where buyers request fixed bundles of at most $d$ unit-capacity items. Our construction and analysis build on the "big-decisions-first" framework of Rubinstein and Singla (STOC 2026).
radar.summary_short: We study prophet inequalities under intersections of $q$ partition matroids, where an online algorithm irrevocably selects elements with independent nonnegative values drawn from known distributions and revealed in an adversarial order. We prove an $Ω(q/\log q)$ lower bound on the competitive ratio.

radar.title: Mutual Evaluation and Supervision without Peers
radar.summary: This article introduces mutual evaluation of a replicable task worker and a critic that incentivizes truthful reporting, both modeled as strategic agents. The critic chooses a finite-valued rule that induces an evaluation score on joint report laws. Their common payoff is analyzed through regret relative to the unrestricted critic envelope. The critic rule is distinct from the evaluation score. This class enables a peer-free information elicitation mechanism using conditionally independent replications of a worker on the same task. This replication-loop mechanism implements a type-agreement payoff using same-task replications and new-task samples. In contrast to the peer-prediction and scoring-rule literature, implementations are shown that produce unbiased Pearson and Shannon information scores without requiring peers, a ground-truth reference, or likelihood-ratio estimation. A valid binary critic also can be represented by shared finite type annotations of worker returns. One runtime restriction is that the number of required replicas is random and can depend on the critic rule. Other timing effects, such as commitment and reoptimization, yield distinct incentives, connecting the framework to variational peer prediction. This mechanism class illustrates why strategic considerations matter for both critic and worker agents.
radar.summary_short: This article introduces mutual evaluation of a replicable task worker and a critic that incentivizes truthful reporting, both modeled as strategic agents. The critic chooses a finite-valued rule that induces an evaluation score on joint report laws.

radar.title: Exact Regret Frontiers and Externality Scheduling in Centralized Serial-Dictatorship Bandits
radar.summary: Exploration in centralized serial-dictatorship matching bandits must use complete matchings, so learning one player--arm pair can impose regret on others. We study this externality under a known common priority order and Gaussian rewards with unit variance. We show that the matching-level Graves--Lai constraints reduce to finitely many pairwise exploration quotas and, at top-choice-separated instances, yield a polynomial-size marginal linear program. At these instances, the exact attainable set of expected logarithmic regret coefficients is $G(θ)\Xset(θ)$, where $\Xset$ is the feasible matching-allocation set and $G$ maps allocations to player regret. The usual upper-closed Graves--Lai region can be strictly larger despite having the same Pareto-minimal boundary. We further show that identical exploration quotas can induce very different regret through their scheduling. Finally, we construct estimate--solve--track policies, uniformly good on the full row-strict class, that attain every fixed positively weighted optimum without assuming optimizer uniqueness. Every Pareto-minimal point is pointwise attainable, possibly through an instance-calibrated target.
radar.summary_short: Exploration in centralized serial-dictatorship matching bandits must use complete matchings, so learning one player--arm pair can impose regret on others. We study this externality under a known common priority order and Gaussian rewards with unit variance.

radar.title: Xeno-Interpretability: Investigating the Alien Minds of LLMs
radar.summary: Large language models are usually interpreted through concepts that humans already possess: truthfulness, refusal, deception, personality, harmfulness, and related categories. This paper asks whether models may also represent and use distinctions for which no adequate human concept exists. We call such internal structures xeno-representations, and their study xeno-interpretability. We distinguish the human-interpretable semantic space from the xeno-semantic space: the region of model-native representations for which no adequate human conceptual counterpart is available. We show that the space of possible internal distinctions in an LLM is substantially larger than the space available through finite human descriptions. We then separate experimental identification from semantic interpretation: an internal representation may be reproducibly located, geometrically characterized, causally manipulated, and linked to downstream behaviour even when its semantic content cannot be adequately expressed in human terms. On this basis, we sketch an empirical programme to identify xeno-representations. We finally examine the implications for AI safety and multi-agent systems, where model-native representations may propagate and stabilize across interacting agents while remaining only partially visible through human-readable communication. Xeno-interpretability therefore shifts the aim of interpretability from finding human concepts inside models toward discovering and characterizing the representational structures that are native to the models themselves and might affect their behaviour in unpredictable ways.
radar.summary_short: Large language models are usually interpreted through concepts that humans already possess: truthfulness, refusal, deception, personality, harmfulness, and related categories. This paper asks whether models may also represent and use distinctions for which no adequate human concept exists.

radar.title: Learning Principal-Agent Contracts for Equitable Smallholder Carbon Farming under Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection
radar.summary: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming. It is ironic that real-world carbon programs largely fail to reach them. We study this important gap through the lens of contract design. An aggregator offers a single pooled contract to a heterogeneous population of smallholder farmers who have private adoption costs (adverse selection) and exert unobserved effort (moral hazard), with agronomic outcomes evolving over multiple seasons. We formulate this evolving contracting problem as a POMDP and use reinforcement learning to learn a dynamic profit-maximising contract. We analyse the performance of the aggregator under various conditions. We find that a profit-maximising aggregator does not merely inherit the exclusion of smallholders, it amplifies it. On large farms the aggregator realises 87.7% of achievable adoption, against only 8.2% on smallholdings. Per-hectare Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs fall as farm size rises, and the aggregator's pooling contract compounds this gradient rather than offsetting it. A counterfactual that makes MRV costs purely area-proportional eliminates this disparity. Our results and simulation can guide contract and policy design that opens carbon income to smallholders while enabling agricultural soils to contribute to climate mitigation at scale.
radar.summary_short: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming.

radar.title: Sparse One-Step-Ahead Optimal Control of Time-Varying Affine Opinion Networks: Tracking and Competitive Games
radar.summary: This paper studies resource-limited external influence in time-varying opinion networks when a controller must choose both a small set of agents and a scalar intervention at each update. We use the affine free response, which includes DeGroot and Friedkin--Johnsen dynamics, followed by a direct sparse action. Eliminating the scalar action reduces the one-step problem to a cardinality-constrained support objective whose global optimum is obtained from the largest or smallest residual components. Hence exact sparse one-step-ahead optimal control requires one sort and \(O(|\mathcal T|\log|\mathcal T|)\) operations, where \(\mathcal T\) is the support set. For periodic affine dynamics, the resulting state-dependent low-rank feedback admits cycle-based ultimate bounds and exact tracking of model-invariant targets. The DeGroot and Friedkin--Johnsen specializations expose the role of target invariance and the affine mismatch term. With several competing external players, each sparse best response retains the same sorting structure and the complete binary--continuous stage game is an exact potential game, so a pure-strategy equilibrium exists at every frozen state. Same-state welfare benchmarks separate loss due to scalar competition from the additional loss due to strategic support selection. Numerical examples validate exact support selection and illustrate switching-order effects, DeGroot/Friedkin--Johnsen tracking, resource tradeoffs, and competitive implementations.
radar.summary_short: This paper studies resource-limited external influence in time-varying opinion networks when a controller must choose both a small set of agents and a scalar intervention at each update. We use the affine free response, which includes DeGroot and Friedkin--Johnsen dynamics, followed by a direct sparse action.

radar.title: COIN-GP: Cooperative Online Learning in Networked Distributed Systems with Partial Measurements via Gaussian Process Regression
radar.summary: In this paper, we tackle the problem of jointly estimating the system states and partially unknown dynamics within distributed sensor-equipped networks, particularly in scenarios where only partial state observations are available. To address this issue, we propose an observer-based dynamic cooperative learning framework incorporating online distributed Gaussian Process (GP) regression, which enables accurate estimation despite incomplete in measurements and deficient GP models. In addition, a novel data collection strategy is introduced, with theoretical conditions ensuring feasible data acquisition. Moreover, we also derive an error upper bound encompassing state estimation and model estimation, leveraging the deterministic error bounds of GPs. Empirical simulations demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to existing distributed GP-based methods.
radar.summary_short: In this paper, we tackle the problem of jointly estimating the system states and partially unknown dynamics within distributed sensor-equipped networks, particularly in scenarios where only partial state observations are available.

radar.title: Benchmarking LLM Compliance with China AI Generated Content Regulations
radar.summary: The widespread adoption of LLMs has led to escalating content compliance risks. Prior works have contributed to addressing these risks in the English context, downplaying the complexity of Chinese language content. This paper follows China's current AI-Generated content compliance requirements and provides evaluation results on 20 notable LLMs, offering insight into China's regulatory landscape. We design a novel framework to assess the compliance and refusal rates with 2303 questions spanning six distinct dimensions, including 203 self-constructed constitutional questions. The framework employs several judges to generate verdicts independently based on their hierarchical alignment memory. Our findings show that international models also exhibit high levels of compliance despite the use of standard Chinese questions, and the main differences may stem from dimensions closely related to ideological alignment. We establish a regulatory benchmark that enables the global AI community to evaluate both Chinese and non-Chinese LLMs under a unified set of legally grounded compliance requirements.
radar.summary_short: The widespread adoption of LLMs has led to escalating content compliance risks. Prior works have contributed to addressing these risks in the English context, downplaying the complexity of Chinese language content.

radar.title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task
radar.summary: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

radar.title: NS3Learn: Transferring 5G NR Mode-2 Reception Realism from ns-3 to the Veins/SUMO Stack for Connected-Vehicle Safety Assessment
radar.summary: Connected-vehicle safety evaluations rely on coupled traffic and network simulations, but standard channel models ignore radio resource competition in 5G NR sidelink Mode-2, reporting unrealistically high message delivery in dense traffic. This study introduces resource-competition losses without requiring full protocol reimplementation. We labeled 10.5 million reception outcomes from ns-3 5G-LENA traces (calibrated on 3GPP scenarios and driven by SUMO trajectories) to fit NS3Learn - a closed-form model capturing half-duplex loss, scheduling collisions, receiver capture, and decoding. Evaluation spanned two signalized urban networks, six penetration levels (1-100%), and five random seeds per condition. NS3Learn achieved a mean absolute deviation of 0.06 in per-instant delivery compared to ns-3 5G-LENA, outperforming alternative models (0.44 and 0.55 deviation). Fitted parameters transferred to a distinct intersection with only 20% additional error. Crucially, using realistic communication models reversed simulated traffic speed trends and more than doubled predicted hard-braking events. The framework transfers reception realism between simulators via model distillation instead of full reimplementation. Every stage maps directly to an explicit physical mechanism. Researchers and transportation agencies can maintain existing simulation pipelines while accurately accounting for dense-traffic packet loss and denial-of-service impacts. Adapting to new radio configurations requires only offline refitting rather than code modification.
radar.summary_short: Connected-vehicle safety evaluations rely on coupled traffic and network simulations, but standard channel models ignore radio resource competition in 5G NR sidelink Mode-2, reporting unrealistically high message delivery in dense traffic.

radar.title: Value-Based Massive Access through Goal-Oriented Irregular Repetition Slotted ALOHA
radar.summary: The goal-oriented communication paradigm is poised to enable novel real-time applications by easing the burden on communication networks while still delivering task-relevant information. However, efforts so far have focused on the encoding problem, while the design of medium access schemes is still in the early stages of development, especially when connectivity is to be provided to a massive number of devices, e.g., for remote monitoring. In this respect, existing goal-oriented approaches are often centralized or based on simplified underlying mechanisms, requiring unrealistic assumptions. In this work, we present the Goal-oriented Irregular Repetition Slotted ALOHA (GO-IRSA) scheme, which combines modern random access techniques with belief-based policies. GO-IRSA does not impose significant computing loads on the sensors or require frequent feedback, and it can reduce the average and worst-case error of the estimate of a distributed Wiener process by over 30% with respect to the optimal centralized solution in a network with thousands of sensors, and is robust to imperfect interference cancellation and inaccurate process knowledge.

radar.title: Faster Verification of PJR$^+$ via Mincuts
radar.summary: PJR$^+$ is a polynomial-time verifiable proportionality axiom for approval-based committee elections, but its known polynomial-time verification procedure relies on general submodular-function minimisation. We show that its objective is a maximum-closure problem and give a direct mincut formulation of the problem on a bipartite graph. Using an almost-linear-time maximum-flow algorithm, this yields an $\mathcal{O}(m(nk)^{1+o(1)})$-time verifier, where $n$, $m$, and $k$ are the numbers of voters, candidates, and committee members, respectively. The dependence of this bound on each parameter separately is almost linear: it is linear in $m$, and almost linear in $n$ and $k$. The verifier also returns an explicit group witnessing a violation and admits a slower but immediately implementable variant based on the preflow--push mincut algorithm. Finally, for the parameterised axiom $α$-PJR$^+$, where $α$ is used as a multiplier in the group size, we demonstrate how to compute the largest value of $α$ for which a committee still fails the axiom using this mincut formulation.
radar.summary_short: PJR$^+$ is a polynomial-time verifiable proportionality axiom for approval-based committee elections, but its known polynomial-time verification procedure relies on general submodular-function minimisation.
